items.title: Eligibility first
items.body: Check card type, account eligibility, minimum spend, caps, exclusions, and offer period. A headline discount is useless if you're ineligible.

items.title: Effective value
items.body: Compare reward/cashback against fees, interest, foreign charges, or spending you wouldn't otherwise do. Net value matters.
